name: Workflow-Mining over OPLMCP Traffic -- meter employee M365-MCP patterns into scoped, verified workflows
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-24: meter the M365-MCP gateway traffic patterns Opal employees already perform, render them into candidate WORKFLOWS (multi-step procedures), human-interview-scope them, then deterministically synthesize/verify/deploy via the rail. Premise: the procedural-authoring gap is real (too hard for users to author the workflows they'd want); far easier to meter the patterns they already perform. The system proposes; humans dispose. A 6-layer pipeline (L0 capture+distill / L1 sessionize / L2 mine / L3 classify+rank / L4 interview+scope / L5 synth+verify+adopt). Offline-mining + live-routing = ONE recognition engine, two time-horizons (also offers a known workflow at moment-of-need). Privacy = the two-zone model (Andrew rulings): an ephemeral HOT zone (short-TTL, identity-bearing for sessionID-stitch + k-anon distinct-actor counting + interview-targeting) + a durable COLD zone (de-identified k-anonymized signatures ONLY); de-identify-NOT-coarsen; no-identity-persisted; identity dropped at the distillation boundary. Largely an EXTENSION of OPLMCP (not greenfield): rides the gateway's 100%-coverage audit chokepoint (app/tools.py -> audit.log_call -> _emit), the R8 audit-lake (.05, LANDED = the L0 substrate), the per-user in-process identity (ALB-OIDC = the ephemeral hot-zone identity), and the kill-switch+blocklist (mutating-workflow safety, partly built). Net-new = the token-level semantic-signature distill (L0) + result-shape capture + sessionID-stitch + mining/ranking (L2/L3) + the interview/scope UX (L4) + synth/verify (L5). PRIVACY GAP to close first: the .05 lake currently persists user:email (contradicts no-identity-persisted) -> the scoping L0 de-identifies at the distillation boundary (scoping-lake holds zero identity). Scoping-of-record: docs/briefs/oplmcp-workflow-scoping-20260624.md (MSTR, Andrew-sovereign).
